register.notes: No separate packaging register yet — Elektroregistrs covers WEEE/batteries only. The PPWR-mandated producer register is to be created by 12.02.2027 (KEM: registers within 24 months). Packaging compliance runs through the DRN system + contracts with licensed waste managers.

extraTaxes.name: Dabas resursu nodoklis (DRN)
extraTaxes.summary: Natural resources tax on packaging placed on the Latvian market. A contract with a licensed recovery scheme (e.g. LZP, Zaļā josta) exempts from paying DRN at the full statutory rate — that exemption is why scheme membership is the standard route.

thresholds.deMinimis: 0 kg — DRN liability starts with the first packaging placed on the market

notes: membershipRequired false = the legal alternative is paying full DRN. Open question (research-log §8.7): current DRN rates vs scheme service fees; what changes when the PPWR register arrives.
